env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^\[6 8 10 12\]$'
stdout '^arr ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep 'archsimd' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_simd' out/main.go
grep '_logos_a\[0\] \+ _logos_b\[0\]' out/main.go
grep 'return \[4\]float32{' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectsimdarray

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func add4(a, b [4]float32) [4]float32 {
	return a + b
}

func main() {
	a := [4]float32{1, 2, 3, 4}
	b := [4]float32{5, 6, 7, 8}
	fmt.Println(add4(a, b))
	fmt.Println("arr ok")
}
